what_it_is: Skynex is Rheinmetall's networked air-defence system built around the Oerlikon revolver gun (35mm AHEAD ammunition), radar/eo sensors and open command layer, configurable for counter-UAS and C-RAM roles; recent contracts include four systems to an Asian customer.
india_angle: Skynex appears in Indian evaluations of gun-based counter-drone layers for air-base defence; no Indian Skynex order is publicly confirmed. Rheinmetall's Indian joint-venture activity (with Indian partners) is the channel to watch.
